description: A 16 channel polyphonic quantizer over a nine octave keyboard, with per-channel bend and portamento, octave transposes and 32 memory banks of note selections

params.text: Turns that note on or off for quantizing, for every channel at once
Chooses which channel the lights and the knobs show
Slews note changes on every channel, up to 1 second, and is overridden per channel by the portamento input
Adds or takes away semitones from the quantized note on every channel, and is overridden per channel by the bend input

inputs.text: The CV to be quantized, one to 16 channels
While this is connected, the quantized note only changes on a trigger above 0V
Sets the portamento time for each channel, taking over from the portamento knob
Sets the bend in semitones for each channel, taking over from the bend knob
A trigger above 0V moves every selected note down a semitone, carrying from one octave into the next
A trigger above 0V moves every selected note up a semitone, carrying from one octave into the next
A trigger above 0V moves the selected notes in that octave down a semitone; a note pushed past the bottom of the octave is lost
A trigger above 0V moves the selected notes in that octave up a semitone; a note pushed past the top of the octave is lost
A trigger on a channel loads the module memory bank of that number, which is saved in the patch
A trigger on a channel loads the plugin memory bank of that number, which is shared by every instance of the module

outputs.text: The quantized 1V/octave pitch for each channel
A trigger on a channel each time its quantized note changes

notes: the quantizer has no notes to snap to until some are chosen; click the keys to switch notes on
menu: Module Memory Bank holds sixteen slots of selected notes saved in the patch, as Load Module Slot 1 to 16 and Save Module Slot 1 to 16
Clear All Keys turns off every selected note
Quantized Notes Readout shows the note each active channel is quantized to, under the keys
Plugin Memory Bank holds sixteen slots of selected notes shared by every instance of the module, as Load Plugin Slot 1 to 16 and Save Plugin Slot 1 to 16
